_comment: Bill of materials. Shopify does not record what is inside a bundle, so every make list has had to be built by hand and the MAKE-LIST of 2026-09-05 had Triple Threat filed under STILL UNKNOWN. This file is the answer. Anything with confirmed:false is inferred and needs a yes from JR before it drives a production run.

Triple Threat.source: Inferred from the dispatch record for order #2164 (Chris Onukwube), which was packed as butter + pomade + oil.

Wash N' Style Pack.source: Inferred from the dispatch record for order #2162 (Xavier Tate), packed as detangler + shampoo bar + conditioning bar.

Waveplug Elite Starter Pack.source: NEEDS JR. This is 40% of revenue and the one bundle whose contents are not recorded anywhere. Known from the dispatch logs: it ships with a brush in a Curved or Flat variant and a goodwill durag has been packed inside recent ones. The rest is unverified. Ask JR to list it once and set confirmed to true.
